#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif
#ifndef M_SQRT_2
#define M_SQRT_2 0.7071067811865475244
#endif
#ifndef M_SQRT1_2
#define M_SQRT1_2 0.7071067811865475244
#endif
#ifndef M_1_SQRTPI
#define M_1_SQRTPI 0.564189583547756286948
#endif

enum OptionType {
    CALL = 0,
    PUT = 1
};

struct OptionInput {
    int type;           // CALL or PUT
    double strike;      // Strike price
    double spot;        // Spot price
    double q;           // Dividend yield
    double r;           // Risk-free rate
    double t;           // Time to maturity
    double vol;         // Volatility
    double value;       // Expected value (for validation)
    double tol;         // Tolerance
};

// Standard normal cumulative distribution function
inline double cumulativeNormal(const double x) noexcept {
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(x * M_SQRT1_2));
}

// Standard normal probability density function
inline double normalPDF(const double x) noexcept {
    return M_1_SQRTPI * M_SQRT1_2 * exp(-0.5 * x * x);
}

// Black-Scholes formula for European options
double blackScholes(const OptionInput& option) noexcept {
    const double S = option.spot;
    const double K = option.strike;
    const double r = option.r;
    const double q = option.q;
    const double T = option.t;
    const double sigma = option.vol;
    
    if (T <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    
    const double d1 = (log(S / K) + (r - q + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T));
    const double d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt(T);
    
    const double Nd1 = cumulativeNormal(d1);
    const double Nd2 = cumulativeNormal(d2);
    const double discount = exp(-r * T);
    
    double price;
    if (option.type == CALL) {
        price = S * exp(-q * T) * Nd1 - K * discount * Nd2;
    } else { // PUT
        price = K * discount * cumulativeNormal(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * cumulativeNormal(-d1);
    }
    
    return price;
}

// Standard test cases for validation
inline constexpr std::array<OptionInput, 7> getTestOptions() noexcept {
    return {{
        {CALL, 40.00, 42.00, 0.04, 0.08, 0.75, 0.35, 5.0975, 1.0e-3},
        {CALL, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0205, 1.0e-3},
        {CALL, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},
        {CALL, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9413, 1.0e-3},
        {PUT, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9210, 1.0e-3},
        {PUT, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},
        {PUT, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0408, 1.0e-3},
    }};
}

// Generate a larger set of options by scaling the test set
void generateOptions(std::vector<OptionInput>& options, const size_t numOptions) {
    constexpr auto testOptions = getTestOptions();
    options.resize(numOptions);
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numOptions; ++i) {
        // Cycle through test options and vary parameters slightly
        const OptionInput& base = testOptions[i % testOptions.size()];
        options[i] = base;
        
        // Add some variation for larger datasets
        const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (i / static_cast<double>(testOptions.size()));
        options[i].spot *= factor;
        options[i].strike *= factor;
    }
}

bool validateResults(const std::vector<OptionInput>& options, 
                     const std::vector<double>& results) {
    bool allPassed = true;
    const int numChecks = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(10), options.size());
    
    printf("Checking computed option prices:\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < numChecks; ++i) {
        const double computed = results[i];
        const double expected = options[i].value;
        const double error = fabs(computed - expected);
        const double relError = error / (fabs(expected) + 1e-10);
        
        printf("  Option %d: computed=%.4f, expected=%.4f, rel_error=%.4e\n", 
               i, computed, expected, relError);
        
        // Relaxed validation - just check values are positive and reasonable
        if (computed < 0.0 || computed > 1000.0 || std::isnan(computed) || std::isinf(computed)) {
            printf("Validation failed at option %d: invalid value %.4f\n", i, computed);
            allPassed = false;
        }
    }
    
    return allPassed;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of options to price (default: 10000)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation against known values\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t numOptions = 10000;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numOptions = atoll(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("Black-Scholes Option Pricing Benchmark\n");
    printf("Number of options: %zu\n", numOptions);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Generate options
    std::vector<OptionInput> options;
    generateOptions(options, numOptions);
    
    // Allocate results
    std::vector<double> results(numOptions);
    
    // Price options
    printf("Pricing options...\n");
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numOptions; ++i) {
        results[i] = blackScholes(options[i]);
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", duration.count() / 1000.0);
    printf("Options per second: %.0f\n", numOptions / (duration.count() / 1e6));
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        print_results(results, "OptionPrices");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating results...\n");
        bool valid = validateResults(options, results);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

// Black-Scholes formula for European options
double blackScholes(const OptionInput& option) noexcept {
    const double S = option.spot;
    const double K = option.strike;
    const double r = option.r;
    const double q = option.q;
    const double T = option.t;
    const double sigma = option.vol;
    
    if (T <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    
    const double d1 = (log(S / K) + (r - q + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T));
    const double d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt(T);

    } else { // PUT

}

        results[i] = blackScholes(options[i]);
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", duration.count() / 1000.0);
    printf("Options per second: %.0f\n", numOptions / (duration.count() / 1e6));
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        print_results(results, "OptionPrices");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating results...\n");
        bool valid = validateResults(options, results);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}
+
+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
+
+void checkMPI(const int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " +
+                                 std::string(message, static_cast<size_t>(length)));
+    }
+}
+
+void checkCUDA(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr size_t gpuChunkSize = 1u << 18;
+constexpr size_t cpuChunkSize = 1u << 10;
+
+// Claim disjoint batches without overflowing the counter at very large N.
+Range claimWork(std::atomic<size_t>& next, const size_t limit,
+                const size_t batchSize) noexcept {
+    size_t begin = next.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    while (begin < limit) {
+        const size_t count = std::min(batchSize, limit - begin);
+        if (next.compare_exchange_weak(begin, begin + count,
+                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            return {begin, count};
+        }
+    }
+    return {limit, 0};
+}
+
+// One OpenMP worker drives each GPU. Two bounded buffers/streams overlap the
+// next kernel with D2H output, without pinning the entire rank's result array.
+class GPUWorker {
+public:
+    explicit GPUWorker(const int device) : device_(device) {}
+    GPUWorker(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+    GPUWorker& operator=(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+
+    ~GPUWorker() {
+        cudaSetDevice(device_);
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]);
+            if (deviceResults_[slot]) cudaFree(deviceResults_[slot]);
+            if (hostResults_[slot]) cudaFreeHost(hostResults_[slot]);
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamDestroy(streams_[slot]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void initialize(const size_t capacity, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        cudaDeviceProp properties;
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device_), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
+        maxBlocks_ = properties.multiProcessorCount * 8;
+        constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+        checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(deviceSeeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(OptionInput) * seeds.size()),
+                  "cudaMemcpyToSymbol");
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            checkCUDA(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams_[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking),
+                      "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
+            checkCUDA(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults_[slot]),
+                                 capacity * sizeof(double)), "cudaMalloc");
+            if (outputCount) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostResults_[slot]),
+                                         std::min(capacity, outputCount) * sizeof(double)),
+                          "cudaMallocHost");
+            }
+        }
+        // Context creation, module loading and allocation are setup, as input
+        // generation/allocation were in the serial benchmark.
+        priceOptions<<<1, 1, 0, streams_[0]>>>(0, 1, deviceResults_[0]);
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "CUDA warm-up launch");
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[0]), "CUDA warm-up synchronization");
+    }
+
+    void run(const Range initial, const Range rankRange,
+             std::atomic<size_t>& next, const std::atomic<bool>& failed,
+             double* output, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        Range work = initial;
+        int slot = 0;
+        while (work.count && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            finish(slot, output);
+            const int blocks = std::min(maxBlocks_,
+                static_cast<int>((work.count + 255) / 256));
+            priceOptions<<<blocks, 256, 0, streams_[slot]>>>(
+                rankRange.offset + work.offset, work.count, deviceResults_[slot]);
+            checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "priceOptions launch");
+            pending_[slot].offset = work.offset;
+            pending_[slot].count = work.offset < outputCount
+                ? std::min(work.count, outputCount - work.offset) : 0;
+            if (pending_[slot].count) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostResults_[slot], deviceResults_[slot],
+                                         pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double),
+                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streams_[slot]),
+                          "cudaMemcpyAsync");
+            }
+            slot ^= 1;
+            work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, gpuChunkSize);
+        }
+        finish(0, output);
+        finish(1, output);
+    }
+
+private:
+    void finish(const int slot, double* output) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]), "cudaStreamSynchronize");
+        if (pending_[slot].count) {
+            std::memcpy(output + pending_[slot].offset, hostResults_[slot],
+                        pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double));
+            pending_[slot].count = 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int device_;
+    int maxBlocks_ = 1;
+    cudaStream_t streams_[2] = {};
+    double* deviceResults_[2] = {};
+    double* hostResults_[2] = {};
+    Range pending_[2] = {};
+};
+
+void reportWorkerFailure(std::atomic<bool>& failed, const std::exception& error) {
+    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    // Do not call MPI from a worker: MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is sufficient.
+    #pragma omp critical(black_scholes_errors)
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Black-Scholes worker: %s\n", error.what());
+}
+
+void priceOnCPU(const Range rankRange, std::atomic<size_t>& next,
+                const std::atomic<bool>& failed, double* output,
+                const size_t outputCount, double& checksum) noexcept {
+    constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    while (!failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+        const Range work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, cpuChunkSize);
+        if (!work.count) break;
+        #pragma omp simd reduction(+:sum)
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < work.count; ++i) {
+            const size_t localIndex = work.offset + i;
+            const double price = blackScholes(optionAt(seeds.data(), rankRange.offset + localIndex));
+            if (localIndex < outputCount) output[localIndex] = price;
+            sum += price;
+        }
+    }
+    // Retain CPU work even when neither -r nor -v requires host output.
+    checksum = sum;
+}
+
+// Gather ordered output in windows so MPI's int counts/displacements never
+// truncate datasets larger than INT_MAX. No gather is needed without -r/-v.
+void gatherResults(const Range rankRange, const size_t totalCount,
+                   const int rank, const int ranks, double* localOutput,
+                   std::vector<double>& results) {
+    std::vector<int> counts(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    std::vector<int> displacements(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    for (size_t window = 0; window < totalCount;) {
+        const size_t windowCount = std::min(totalCount - window,
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));
+        const size_t end = window + windowCount;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                // rankRange covers the original N, not just the validation prefix.
+                const Range sourceRange = partition(globalOptionCount_, source, ranks);
+                const size_t begin = std::max(window, sourceRange.offset);
+                const size_t sourceEnd = std::min(end, sourceRange.offset + sourceRange.count);
+                counts[source] = sourceEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(sourceEnd - begin) : 0;
+                displacements[source] = counts[source] ? static_cast<int>(begin - window) : 0;
+            }
+        }
+        const size_t begin = std::max(window, rankRange.offset);
+        const size_t localEnd = std::min(end, rankRange.offset + rankRange.count);
+        const int count = localEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(localEnd - begin) : 0;
+        const void* send = rank == 0 ? MPI_IN_PLACE
+            : count ? static_cast<void*>(localOutput + begin - rankRange.offset) : nullptr;
+        checkMPI(MPI_Gatherv(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                            rank == 0 ? results.data() + window : nullptr,
+                            counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+                 "MPI_Gatherv");
+        window = end;
+    }
+}

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;

The hybrid scheduler is in place: each GPU gets an initial batch, then GPU and CPU workers claim disjoint batches. GPU buffers stay bounded as the dataset grows, and MPI gathers only the output requested by `-r` or `-v`. +// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}
+
+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
+
+void checkMPI(const int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " +
+                                 std::string(message, static_cast<size_t>(length)));
+    }
+}
+
+void checkCUDA(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr size_t gpuChunkSize = 1u << 18;
+constexpr size_t cpuChunkSize = 1u << 10;
+
+// Claim disjoint batches without overflowing the counter at very large N.
+Range claimWork(std::atomic<size_t>& next, const size_t limit,
+                const size_t batchSize) noexcept {
+    size_t begin = next.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    while (begin < limit) {
+        const size_t count = std::min(batchSize, limit - begin);
+        if (next.compare_exchange_weak(begin, begin + count,
+                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            return {begin, count};
+        }
+    }
+    return {limit, 0};
+}
+
+// One OpenMP worker drives each GPU. Two bounded buffers/streams overlap the
+// next kernel with D2H output, without pinning the entire rank's result array.
+class GPUWorker {
+public:
+    explicit GPUWorker(const int device) : device_(device) {}
+    GPUWorker(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+    GPUWorker& operator=(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+
+    ~GPUWorker() {
+        cudaSetDevice(device_);
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]);
+            if (deviceResults_[slot]) cudaFree(deviceResults_[slot]);
+            if (hostResults_[slot]) cudaFreeHost(hostResults_[slot]);
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamDestroy(streams_[slot]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void initialize(const size_t capacity, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        cudaDeviceProp properties;
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device_), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
+        maxBlocks_ = properties.multiProcessorCount * 8;
+        constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+        checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(deviceSeeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(OptionInput) * seeds.size()),
+                  "cudaMemcpyToSymbol");
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            checkCUDA(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams_[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking),
+                      "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
+            checkCUDA(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults_[slot]),
+                                 capacity * sizeof(double)), "cudaMalloc");
+            if (outputCount) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostResults_[slot]),
+                                         std::min(capacity, outputCount) * sizeof(double)),
+                          "cudaMallocHost");
+            }
+        }
+        // Context creation, module loading and allocation are setup, as input
+        // generation/allocation were in the serial benchmark.
+        priceOptions<<<1, 1, 0, streams_[0]>>>(0, 1, deviceResults_[0]);
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "CUDA warm-up launch");
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[0]), "CUDA warm-up synchronization");
+    }
+
+    void run(const Range initial, const Range rankRange,
+             std::atomic<size_t>& next, const std::atomic<bool>& failed,
+             double* output, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        Range work = initial;
+        int slot = 0;
+        while (work.count && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            finish(slot, output);
+            const int blocks = std::min(maxBlocks_,
+                static_cast<int>((work.count + 255) / 256));
+            priceOptions<<<blocks, 256, 0, streams_[slot]>>>(
+                rankRange.offset + work.offset, work.count, deviceResults_[slot]);
+            checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "priceOptions launch");
+            pending_[slot].offset = work.offset;
+            pending_[slot].count = work.offset < outputCount
+                ? std::min(work.count, outputCount - work.offset) : 0;
+            if (pending_[slot].count) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostResults_[slot], deviceResults_[slot],
+                                         pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double),
+                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streams_[slot]),
+                          "cudaMemcpyAsync");
+            }
+            slot ^= 1;
+            work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, gpuChunkSize);
+        }
+        finish(0, output);
+        finish(1, output);
+    }
+
+private:
+    void finish(const int slot, double* output) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]), "cudaStreamSynchronize");
+        if (pending_[slot].count) {
+            std::memcpy(output + pending_[slot].offset, hostResults_[slot],
+                        pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double));
+            pending_[slot].count = 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int device_;
+    int maxBlocks_ = 1;
+    cudaStream_t streams_[2] = {};
+    double* deviceResults_[2] = {};
+    double* hostResults_[2] = {};
+    Range pending_[2] = {};
+};
+
+void reportWorkerFailure(std::atomic<bool>& failed, const std::exception& error) {
+    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    // Do not call MPI from a worker: MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is sufficient.
+    #pragma omp critical(black_scholes_errors)
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Black-Scholes worker: %s\n", error.what());
+}
+
+void priceOnCPU(const Range rankRange, std::atomic<size_t>& next,
+                const std::atomic<bool>& failed, double* output,
+                const size_t outputCount, double& checksum) noexcept {
+    constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    while (!failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+        const Range work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, cpuChunkSize);
+        if (!work.count) break;
+        #pragma omp simd reduction(+:sum)
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < work.count; ++i) {
+            const size_t localIndex = work.offset + i;
+            const double price = blackScholes(optionAt(seeds.data(), rankRange.offset + localIndex));
+            if (localIndex < outputCount) output[localIndex] = price;
+            sum += price;
+        }
+    }
+    // Retain CPU work even when neither -r nor -v requires host output.
+    checksum = sum;
+}
+
+// Gather ordered output in windows so MPI's int counts/displacements never
+// truncate datasets larger than INT_MAX. No gather is needed without -r/-v.
+void gatherResults(const Range rankRange, const size_t numOptions, const size_t totalCount,
+                   const int rank, const int ranks, double* localOutput,
+                   std::vector<double>& results) {
+    std::vector<int> counts(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    std::vector<int> displacements(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    for (size_t window = 0; window < totalCount;) {
+        const size_t windowCount = std::min(totalCount - window,
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));
+        const size_t end = window + windowCount;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                // rankRange covers the original N, not just the validation prefix.
+                const Range sourceRange = partition(numOptions, source, ranks);
+                const size_t begin = std::max(window, sourceRange.offset);
+                const size_t sourceEnd = std::min(end, sourceRange.offset + sourceRange.count);
+                counts[source] = sourceEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(sourceEnd - begin) : 0;
+                displacements[source] = counts[source] ? static_cast<int>(begin - window) : 0;
+            }
+        }
+        const size_t begin = std::max(window, rankRange.offset);
+        const size_t localEnd = std::min(end, rankRange.offset + rankRange.count);
+        const int count = localEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(localEnd - begin) : 0;
+        const void* send = rank == 0 ? MPI_IN_PLACE
+            : count ? static_cast<void*>(localOutput + begin - rankRange.offset) : nullptr;
+        checkMPI(MPI_Gatherv(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                            rank == 0 ? results.data() + window : nullptr,
+                            counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+                 "MPI_Gatherv");
+        window = end;
+    }
+}

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}
+
+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
+
+void checkMPI(const int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " +
+                                 std::string(message, static_cast<size_t>(length)));
+    }
+}
+
+void checkCUDA(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr size_t gpuChunkSize = 1u << 18;
+constexpr size_t cpuChunkSize = 1u << 10;
+
+// Claim disjoint batches without overflowing the counter at very large N.
+Range claimWork(std::atomic<size_t>& next, const size_t limit,
+                const size_t batchSize) noexcept {
+    size_t begin = next.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    while (begin < limit) {
+        const size_t count = std::min(batchSize, limit - begin);
+        if (next.compare_exchange_weak(begin, begin + count,
+                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            return {begin, count};
+        }
+    }
+    return {limit, 0};
+}
+
+// One OpenMP worker drives each GPU. Two bounded buffers/streams overlap the
+// next kernel with D2H output, without pinning the entire rank's result array.
+class GPUWorker {
+public:
+    explicit GPUWorker(const int device) : device_(device) {}
+    GPUWorker(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+    GPUWorker& operator=(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+
+    ~GPUWorker() {
+        cudaSetDevice(device_);
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]);
+            if (deviceResults_[slot]) cudaFree(deviceResults_[slot]);
+            if (hostResults_[slot]) cudaFreeHost(hostResults_[slot]);
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamDestroy(streams_[slot]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void initialize(const size_t capacity, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        cudaDeviceProp properties;
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device_), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
+        maxBlocks_ = properties.multiProcessorCount * 8;
+        constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+        checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(deviceSeeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(OptionInput) * seeds.size()),
+                  "cudaMemcpyToSymbol");
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            checkCUDA(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams_[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking),
+                      "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
+            checkCUDA(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults_[slot]),
+                                 capacity * sizeof(double)), "cudaMalloc");
+            if (outputCount) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostResults_[slot]),
+                                         std::min(capacity, outputCount) * sizeof(double)),
+                          "cudaMallocHost");
+            }
+        }
+        // Context creation, module loading and allocation are setup, as input
+        // generation/allocation were in the serial benchmark.
+        priceOptions<<<1, 1, 0, streams_[0]>>>(0, 1, deviceResults_[0]);
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "CUDA warm-up launch");
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[0]), "CUDA warm-up synchronization");
+    }
+
+    void run(const Range initial, const Range rankRange,
+             std::atomic<size_t>& next, const std::atomic<bool>& failed,
+             double* output, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        Range work = initial;
+        int slot = 0;
+        while (work.count && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            finish(slot, output);
+            const int blocks = std::min(maxBlocks_,
+                static_cast<int>((work.count + 255) / 256));
+            priceOptions<<<blocks, 256, 0, streams_[slot]>>>(
+                rankRange.offset + work.offset, work.count, deviceResults_[slot]);
+            checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "priceOptions launch");
+            pending_[slot].offset = work.offset;
+            pending_[slot].count = work.offset < outputCount
+                ? std::min(work.count, outputCount - work.offset) : 0;
+            if (pending_[slot].count) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostResults_[slot], deviceResults_[slot],
+                                         pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double),
+                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streams_[slot]),
+                          "cudaMemcpyAsync");
+            }
+            slot ^= 1;
+            work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, gpuChunkSize);
+        }
+        finish(0, output);
+        finish(1, output);
+    }
+
+private:
+    void finish(const int slot, double* output) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]), "cudaStreamSynchronize");
+        if (pending_[slot].count) {
+            std::memcpy(output + pending_[slot].offset, hostResults_[slot],
+                        pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double));
+            pending_[slot].count = 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int device_;
+    int maxBlocks_ = 1;
+    cudaStream_t streams_[2] = {};
+    double* deviceResults_[2] = {};
+    double* hostResults_[2] = {};
+    Range pending_[2] = {};
+};
+
+void reportWorkerFailure(std::atomic<bool>& failed, const std::exception& error) {
+    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    // Do not call MPI from a worker: MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is sufficient.
+    #pragma omp critical(black_scholes_errors)
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Black-Scholes worker: %s\n", error.what());
+}
+
+void priceOnCPU(const Range rankRange, std::atomic<size_t>& next,
+                const std::atomic<bool>& failed, double* output,
+                const size_t outputCount, double& checksum) noexcept {
+    constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    while (!failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+        const Range work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, cpuChunkSize);
+        if (!work.count) break;
+        #pragma omp simd reduction(+:sum)
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < work.count; ++i) {
+            const size_t localIndex = work.offset + i;
+            const double price = blackScholes(optionAt(seeds.data(), rankRange.offset + localIndex));
+            if (localIndex < outputCount) output[localIndex] = price;
+            sum += price;
+        }
+    }
+    // Retain CPU work even when neither -r nor -v requires host output.
+    checksum = sum;
+}
+
+// Gather ordered output in windows so MPI's int counts/displacements never
+// truncate datasets larger than INT_MAX. No gather is needed without -r/-v.
+void gatherResults(const Range rankRange, const size_t numOptions, const size_t totalCount,
+                   const int rank, const int ranks, double* localOutput,
+                   std::vector<double>& results) {
+    std::vector<int> counts(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    std::vector<int> displacements(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    for (size_t window = 0; window < totalCount;) {
+        const size_t windowCount = std::min(totalCount - window,
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));
+        const size_t end = window + windowCount;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                // rankRange covers the original N, not just the validation prefix.
+                const Range sourceRange = partition(numOptions, source, ranks);
+                const size_t begin = std::max(window, sourceRange.offset);
+                const size_t sourceEnd = std::min(end, sourceRange.offset + sourceRange.count);
+                counts[source] = sourceEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(sourceEnd - begin) : 0;
+                displacements[source] = counts[source] ? static_cast<int>(begin - window) : 0;
+            }
+        }
+        const size_t begin = std::max(window, rankRange.offset);
+        const size_t localEnd = std::min(end, rankRange.offset + rankRange.count);
+        const int count = localEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(localEnd - begin) : 0;
+        const void* send = rank == 0 ? MPI_IN_PLACE
+            : count ? static_cast<void*>(localOutput + begin - rankRange.offset) : nullptr;
+        checkMPI(MPI_Gatherv(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                            rank == 0 ? results.data() + window : nullptr,
+                            counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+                 "MPI_Gatherv");
+        window = end;
+    }
+}

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}
+
+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
+
+void checkMPI(const int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " +
+                                 std::string(message, static_cast<size_t>(length)));
+    }
+}
+
+void checkCUDA(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr size_t gpuChunkSize = 1u << 18;
+constexpr size_t cpuChunkSize = 1u << 10;
+
+// Claim disjoint batches without overflowing the counter at very large N.
+Range claimWork(std::atomic<size_t>& next, const size_t limit,
+                const size_t batchSize) noexcept {
+    size_t begin = next.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    while (begin < limit) {
+        const size_t count = std::min(batchSize, limit - begin);
+        if (next.compare_exchange_weak(begin, begin + count,
+                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            return {begin, count};
+        }
+    }
+    return {limit, 0};
+}
+
+// One OpenMP worker drives each GPU. Two bounded buffers/streams overlap the
+// next kernel with D2H output, without pinning the entire rank's result array.
+class GPUWorker {
+public:
+    explicit GPUWorker(const int device) : device_(device) {}
+    GPUWorker(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+    GPUWorker& operator=(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+
+    ~GPUWorker() {
+        cudaSetDevice(device_);
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]);
+            if (deviceResults_[slot]) cudaFree(deviceResults_[slot]);
+            if (hostResults_[slot]) cudaFreeHost(hostResults_[slot]);
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamDestroy(streams_[slot]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void initialize(const size_t capacity, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        cudaDeviceProp properties;
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device_), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
+        maxBlocks_ = properties.multiProcessorCount * 8;
+        constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+        checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(deviceSeeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(OptionInput) * seeds.size()),
+                  "cudaMemcpyToSymbol");
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            checkCUDA(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams_[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking),
+                      "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
+            checkCUDA(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults_[slot]),
+                                 capacity * sizeof(double)), "cudaMalloc");
+            if (outputCount) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostResults_[slot]),
+                                         std::min(capacity, outputCount) * sizeof(double)),
+                          "cudaMallocHost");
+            }
+        }
+        // Context creation, module loading and allocation are setup, as input
+        // generation/allocation were in the serial benchmark.
+        priceOptions<<<1, 1, 0, streams_[0]>>>(0, 1, deviceResults_[0]);
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "CUDA warm-up launch");
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[0]), "CUDA warm-up synchronization");
+    }
+
+    void run(const Range initial, const Range rankRange,
+             std::atomic<size_t>& next, const std::atomic<bool>& failed,
+             double* output, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        Range work = initial;
+        int slot = 0;
+        while (work.count && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            finish(slot, output);
+            const int blocks = std::min(maxBlocks_,
+                static_cast<int>((work.count + 255) / 256));
+            priceOptions<<<blocks, 256, 0, streams_[slot]>>>(
+                rankRange.offset + work.offset, work.count, deviceResults_[slot]);
+            checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "priceOptions launch");
+            pending_[slot].offset = work.offset;
+            pending_[slot].count = work.offset < outputCount
+                ? std::min(work.count, outputCount - work.offset) : 0;
+            if (pending_[slot].count) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostResults_[slot], deviceResults_[slot],
+                                         pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double),
+                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streams_[slot]),
+                          "cudaMemcpyAsync");
+            }
+            slot ^= 1;
+            work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, gpuChunkSize);
+        }
+        finish(0, output);
+        finish(1, output);
+    }
+
+private:
+    void finish(const int slot, double* output) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]), "cudaStreamSynchronize");
+        if (pending_[slot].count) {
+            std::memcpy(output + pending_[slot].offset, hostResults_[slot],
+                        pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double));
+            pending_[slot].count = 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int device_;
+    int maxBlocks_ = 1;
+    cudaStream_t streams_[2] = {};
+    double* deviceResults_[2] = {};
+    double* hostResults_[2] = {};
+    Range pending_[2] = {};
+};
+
+void reportWorkerFailure(std::atomic<bool>& failed, const std::exception& error) {
+    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    // Do not call MPI from a worker: MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is sufficient.
+    #pragma omp critical(black_scholes_errors)
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Black-Scholes worker: %s\n", error.what());
+}
+
+void priceOnCPU(const Range rankRange, std::atomic<size_t>& next,
+                const std::atomic<bool>& failed, double* output,
+                const size_t outputCount, double& checksum) noexcept {
+    constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    while (!failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+        const Range work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, cpuChunkSize);
+        if (!work.count) break;
+        #pragma omp simd reduction(+:sum)
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < work.count; ++i) {
+            const size_t localIndex = work.offset + i;
+            const double price = blackScholes(optionAt(seeds.data(), rankRange.offset + localIndex));
+            if (localIndex < outputCount) output[localIndex] = price;
+            sum += price;
+        }
+    }
+    // Retain CPU work even when neither -r nor -v requires host output.
+    checksum = sum;
+}
+
+// Gather ordered output in windows so MPI's int counts/displacements never
+// truncate datasets larger than INT_MAX. No gather is needed without -r/-v.
+void gatherResults(const Range rankRange, const size_t numOptions, const size_t totalCount,
+                   const int rank, const int ranks, double* localOutput,
+                   std::vector<double>& results) {
+    std::vector<int> counts(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    std::vector<int> displacements(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    for (size_t window = 0; window < totalCount;) {
+        const size_t windowCount = std::min(totalCount - window,
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));
+        const size_t end = window + windowCount;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                // rankRange covers the original N, not just the validation prefix.
+                const Range sourceRange = partition(numOptions, source, ranks);
+                const size_t begin = std::max(window, sourceRange.offset);
+                const size_t sourceEnd = std::min(end, sourceRange.offset + sourceRange.count);
+                counts[source] = sourceEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(sourceEnd - begin) : 0;
+                displacements[source] = counts[source] ? static_cast<int>(begin - window) : 0;
+            }
+        }
+        const size_t begin = std::max(window, rankRange.offset);
+        const size_t localEnd = std::min(end, rankRange.offset + rankRange.count);
+        const int count = localEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(localEnd - begin) : 0;
+        const void* send = rank == 0 ? MPI_IN_PLACE
+            : count ? static_cast<void*>(localOutput + begin - rankRange.offset) : nullptr;
+        checkMPI(MPI_Gatherv(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                            rank == 0 ? results.data() + window : nullptr,
+                            counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+                 "MPI_Gatherv");
+        window = end;
+    }
+}

     constexpr auto testOptions = getTestOptions();

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}
+
+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
+
+void checkMPI(const int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " +
+                                 std::string(message, static_cast<size_t>(length)));
+    }
+}
+
+void checkCUDA(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr size_t gpuChunkSize = 1u << 18;
+constexpr size_t cpuChunkSize = 1u << 10;
+
+// Claim disjoint batches without overflowing the counter at very large N.
+Range claimWork(std::atomic<size_t>& next, const size_t limit,
+                const size_t batchSize) noexcept {
+    size_t begin = next.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    while (begin < limit) {
+        const size_t count = std::min(batchSize, limit - begin);
+        if (next.compare_exchange_weak(begin, begin + count,
+                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            return {begin, count};
+        }
+    }
+    return {limit, 0};
+}
+
+// One OpenMP worker drives each GPU. Two bounded buffers/streams overlap the
+// next kernel with D2H output, without pinning the entire rank's result array.
+class GPUWorker {
+public:
+    explicit GPUWorker(const int device) : device_(device) {}
+    GPUWorker(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+    GPUWorker& operator=(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+
+    ~GPUWorker() {
+        cudaSetDevice(device_);
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]);
+            if (deviceResults_[slot]) cudaFree(deviceResults_[slot]);
+            if (hostResults_[slot]) cudaFreeHost(hostResults_[slot]);
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamDestroy(streams_[slot]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void initialize(const size_t capacity, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        cudaDeviceProp properties;
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device_), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
+        maxBlocks_ = properties.multiProcessorCount * 8;
+        constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+        checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(deviceSeeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(OptionInput) * seeds.size()),
+                  "cudaMemcpyToSymbol");
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            checkCUDA(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams_[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking),
+                      "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
+            checkCUDA(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults_[slot]),
+                                 capacity * sizeof(double)), "cudaMalloc");
+            if (outputCount) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostResults_[slot]),
+                                         std::min(capacity, outputCount) * sizeof(double)),
+                          "cudaMallocHost");
+            }
+        }
+        // Context creation, module loading and allocation are setup, as input
+        // generation/allocation were in the serial benchmark.
+        priceOptions<<<1, 1, 0, streams_[0]>>>(0, 1, deviceResults_[0]);
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "CUDA warm-up launch");
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[0]), "CUDA warm-up synchronization");
+    }
+
+    void run(const Range initial, const Range rankRange,
+             std::atomic<size_t>& next, const std::atomic<bool>& failed,
+             double* output, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        Range work = initial;
+        int slot = 0;
+        while (work.count && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            finish(slot, output);
+            const int blocks = std::min(maxBlocks_,
+                static_cast<int>((work.count + 255) / 256));
+            priceOptions<<<blocks, 256, 0, streams_[slot]>>>(
+                rankRange.offset + work.offset, work.count, deviceResults_[slot]);
+            checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "priceOptions launch");
+            pending_[slot].offset = work.offset;
+            pending_[slot].count = work.offset < outputCount
+                ? std::min(work.count, outputCount - work.offset) : 0;
+            if (pending_[slot].count) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostResults_[slot], deviceResults_[slot],
+                                         pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double),
+                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streams_[slot]),
+                          "cudaMemcpyAsync");
+            }
+            slot ^= 1;
+            work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, gpuChunkSize);
+        }
+        finish(0, output);
+        finish(1, output);
+    }
+
+private:
+    void finish(const int slot, double* output) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]), "cudaStreamSynchronize");
+        if (pending_[slot].count) {
+            std::memcpy(output + pending_[slot].offset, hostResults_[slot],
+                        pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double));
+            pending_[slot].count = 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int device_;
+    int maxBlocks_ = 1;
+    cudaStream_t streams_[2] = {};
+    double* deviceResults_[2] = {};
+    double* hostResults_[2] = {};
+    Range pending_[2] = {};
+};
+
+void reportWorkerFailure(std::atomic<bool>& failed, const std::exception& error) {
+    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    // Do not call MPI from a worker: MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is sufficient.
+    #pragma omp critical(black_scholes_errors)
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Black-Scholes worker: %s\n", error.what());
+}
+
+void priceOnCPU(const Range rankRange, std::atomic<size_t>& next,
+                const std::atomic<bool>& failed, double* output,
+                const size_t outputCount, double& checksum) noexcept {
+    constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    while (!failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+        const Range work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, cpuChunkSize);
+        if (!work.count) break;
+        #pragma omp simd reduction(+:sum)
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < work.count; ++i) {
+            const size_t localIndex = work.offset + i;
+            const double price = blackScholes(optionAt(seeds.data(), rankRange.offset + localIndex));
+            if (localIndex < outputCount) output[localIndex] = price;
+            sum += price;
+        }
+    }
+    // Retain CPU work even when neither -r nor -v requires host output.
+    checksum = sum;
+}
+
+// Gather ordered output in windows so MPI's int counts/displacements never
+// truncate datasets larger than INT_MAX. No gather is needed without -r/-v.
+void gatherResults(const Range rankRange, const size_t numOptions, const size_t totalCount,
+                   const int rank, const int ranks, double* localOutput,
+                   std::vector<double>& results) {
+    std::vector<int> counts(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    std::vector<int> displacements(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    for (size_t window = 0; window < totalCount;) {
+        const size_t windowCount = std::min(totalCount - window,
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));
+        const size_t end = window + windowCount;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                // rankRange covers the original N, not just the validation prefix.
+                const Range sourceRange = partition(numOptions, source, ranks);
+                const size_t begin = std::max(window, sourceRange.offset);
+                const size_t sourceEnd = std::min(end, sourceRange.offset + sourceRange.count);
+                counts[source] = sourceEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(sourceEnd - begin) : 0;
+                displacements[source] = counts[source] ? static_cast<int>(begin - window) : 0;
+            }
+        }

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}

+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
+
+void checkMPI(const int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " +
+                                 std::string(message, static_cast<size_t>(length)));
+    }
+}
+
+void checkCUDA(const cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr size_t gpuChunkSize = 1u << 18;
+constexpr size_t cpuChunkSize = 1u << 10;
+
+// Claim disjoint batches without overflowing the counter at very large N.
+Range claimWork(std::atomic<size_t>& next, const size_t limit,
+                const size_t batchSize) noexcept {
+    size_t begin = next.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    while (begin < limit) {
+        const size_t count = std::min(batchSize, limit - begin);
+        if (next.compare_exchange_weak(begin, begin + count,
+                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            return {begin, count};
+        }
+    }
+    return {limit, 0};
+}
+
+// One OpenMP worker drives each GPU. Two bounded buffers/streams overlap the
+// next kernel with D2H output, without pinning the entire rank's result array.
+class GPUWorker {
+public:
+    explicit GPUWorker(const int device) : device_(device) {}
+    GPUWorker(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+    GPUWorker& operator=(const GPUWorker&) = delete;
+
+    ~GPUWorker() {
+        cudaSetDevice(device_);
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]);
+            if (deviceResults_[slot]) cudaFree(deviceResults_[slot]);
+            if (hostResults_[slot]) cudaFreeHost(hostResults_[slot]);
+            if (streams_[slot]) cudaStreamDestroy(streams_[slot]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void initialize(const size_t capacity, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        cudaDeviceProp properties;
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device_), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
+        maxBlocks_ = properties.multiProcessorCount * 8;
+        constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+        checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(deviceSeeds, seeds.data(), sizeof(OptionInput) * seeds.size()),
+                  "cudaMemcpyToSymbol");
+        for (int slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
+            checkCUDA(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams_[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking),
+                      "cudaStreamCreateWithFlags");
+            checkCUDA(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults_[slot]),
+                                 capacity * sizeof(double)), "cudaMalloc");
+            if (outputCount) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostResults_[slot]),
+                                         std::min(capacity, outputCount) * sizeof(double)),
+                          "cudaMallocHost");
+            }
+        }
+        // Context creation, module loading and allocation are setup, as input
+        // generation/allocation were in the serial benchmark.
+        priceOptions<<<1, 1, 0, streams_[0]>>>(0, 1, deviceResults_[0]);
+        checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "CUDA warm-up launch");
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[0]), "CUDA warm-up synchronization");
+    }
+
+    void run(const Range initial, const Range rankRange,
+             std::atomic<size_t>& next, const std::atomic<bool>& failed,
+             double* output, const size_t outputCount) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaSetDevice(device_), "cudaSetDevice");
+        Range work = initial;
+        int slot = 0;
+        while (work.count && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            finish(slot, output);
+            const int blocks = std::min(maxBlocks_,
+                static_cast<int>((work.count + 255) / 256));
+            priceOptions<<<blocks, 256, 0, streams_[slot]>>>(
+                rankRange.offset + work.offset, work.count, deviceResults_[slot]);
+            checkCUDA(cudaGetLastError(), "priceOptions launch");
+            pending_[slot].offset = work.offset;
+            pending_[slot].count = work.offset < outputCount
+                ? std::min(work.count, outputCount - work.offset) : 0;
+            if (pending_[slot].count) {
+                checkCUDA(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostResults_[slot], deviceResults_[slot],
+                                         pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double),
+                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, streams_[slot]),
+                          "cudaMemcpyAsync");
+            }
+            slot ^= 1;
+            work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, gpuChunkSize);
+        }
+        finish(0, output);
+        finish(1, output);
+    }
+
+private:
+    void finish(const int slot, double* output) {
+        checkCUDA(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams_[slot]), "cudaStreamSynchronize");
+        if (pending_[slot].count) {
+            std::memcpy(output + pending_[slot].offset, hostResults_[slot],
+                        pending_[slot].count * sizeof(double));
+            pending_[slot].count = 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int device_;
+    int maxBlocks_ = 1;
+    cudaStream_t streams_[2] = {};
+    double* deviceResults_[2] = {};
+    double* hostResults_[2] = {};
+    Range pending_[2] = {};
+};
+
+void reportWorkerFailure(std::atomic<bool>& failed, const std::exception& error) {
+    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    // Do not call MPI from a worker: MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is sufficient.
+    #pragma omp critical(black_scholes_errors)
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Black-Scholes worker: %s\n", error.what());
+}
+
+void priceOnCPU(const Range rankRange, std::atomic<size_t>& next,
+                const std::atomic<bool>& failed, double* output,
+                const size_t outputCount, double& checksum) noexcept {
+    constexpr auto seeds = getTestOptions();
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    while (!failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
+        const Range work = claimWork(next, rankRange.count, cpuChunkSize);
+        if (!work.count) break;
+        #pragma omp simd reduction(+:sum)
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < work.count; ++i) {
+            const size_t localIndex = work.offset + i;
+            const double price = blackScholes(optionAt(seeds.data(), rankRange.offset + localIndex));
+            if (localIndex < outputCount) output[localIndex] = price;
+            sum += price;
+        }
+    }
+    // Retain CPU work even when neither -r nor -v requires host output.
+    checksum = sum;
+}
+
+// Gather ordered output in windows so MPI's int counts/displacements never
+// truncate datasets larger than INT_MAX. No gather is needed without -r/-v.
+void gatherResults(const Range rankRange, const size_t numOptions, const size_t totalCount,
+                   const int rank, const int ranks, double* localOutput,
+                   std::vector<double>& results) {
+    std::vector<int> counts(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    std::vector<int> displacements(rank == 0 ? ranks : 0);
+    for (size_t window = 0; window < totalCount;) {
+        const size_t windowCount = std::min(totalCount - window,
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max()));
+        const size_t end = window + windowCount;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                // rankRange covers the original N, not just the validation prefix.
+                const Range sourceRange = partition(numOptions, source, ranks);
+                const size_t begin = std::max(window, sourceRange.offset);
+                const size_t sourceEnd = std::min(end, sourceRange.offset + sourceRange.count);
+                counts[source] = sourceEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(sourceEnd - begin) : 0;
+                displacements[source] = counts[source] ? static_cast<int>(begin - window) : 0;
+            }
+        }
+        const size_t begin = std::max(window, rankRange.offset);
+        const size_t localEnd = std::min(end, rankRange.offset + rankRange.count);
+        const int count = localEnd > begin ? static_cast<int>(localEnd - begin) : 0;
+        const void* send = rank == 0 ? MPI_IN_PLACE
+            : count ? static_cast<void*>(localOutput + begin - rankRange.offset) : nullptr;
+        checkMPI(MPI_Gatherv(send, count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                            rank == 0 ? results.data() + window : nullptr,
+                            counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+                 "MPI_Gatherv");
+        window = end;
+    }
+}

+// Generate each input from its GLOBAL index. Ranks and devices need only the
+// seven seeds, rather than an O(N) input array or an MPI scatter/H2D transfer.
+__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput optionAt(const OptionInput* seeds,
+                                               const size_t index) noexcept {
+    OptionInput option = seeds[index % 7];
+    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (index / 7.0);
+    option.spot *= factor;
+    option.strike *= factor;
+    return option;
+}
+
+__constant__ OptionInput deviceSeeds[7];
+
+__global__ void priceOptions(const size_t globalOffset, const size_t count,
+                             double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         i < count; i += stride) {
+        results[i] = blackScholes(optionAt(deviceSeeds, globalOffset + i));
+    }
+}

+struct Range {
+    size_t offset;
+    size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partition(const size_t count, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
+    const size_t base = count / static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t extra = count % static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    return {base * static_cast<size_t>(rank) +
+                std::min(static_cast<size_t>(rank), extra),
+            base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < extra ? 1 : 0)};
+}
